commits_info.message:
2.23.17 release (previous 2.23.16) + release notes updated by CI build 3846

[ci skip-release]
Add package info to satisfy javadoc plugin and exclude it to avoid adding a package to the module.

Move the mock method dispatcher to a dedicated package to avoid class loaders to skip the bootstrap class loader if Mockito is loaded as an automatic module due to the class's package being assigned to Mockito already.
Work-around possible JVM bug by specifying a class loader for the injected class explicitly. Add tests to check behavior of using Mockito as automatic module.

Try to fix Javadoc generation on Java 11

Explicitly set the source to Java 8. Inspired by
https://github.com/junit-team/junit5/commit/d4da20f71367549538c0a9b100fa67ce674d065d
which fixed the issue in JUnit.
